name: Hospitality
description: Hotel and short-stay lodging operations: property/room/rate setup, availability and reservations, front-desk check-in/out and folio, and distribution to online travel agencies via a channel manager.

sources.title: Frappe Hospitality
sources.notes: Reference-only (GPL-3.0). ERPNext hotel module: Hotel Room, Hotel Room Type, Hotel Room Amenity, Hotel Room Pricing (+Item/Package), Hotel Room Reservation (+Item), Hotel Settings doctypes. Shared with domains/restaurant.

sources.title: QloApps (PrestaShop-based hotel booking engine + channel manager)
sources.notes: Not cloned (inspected via gh api git tree + raw.githubusercontent.com; 132MB repo, PrestaShop e-commerce core + hotelreservationsystem module). OSL-3.0 verified from actual LICENSE.md — a network/external-deployment copyleft license (section 5), treated with the same caution as AGPL: reference-only, no code copied. modules/hotelreservationsystem/classes/ has ~35 Hotel*/RoomType*/ServiceProduct* classes covering branches, room types, rooms, feature-based rate pricing + restrictions, booking detail + status history (Assigned/CheckedIn/CheckedOut/NoShow/Cancelled), advanced payment, refund rules, connected rooms, channel manager + ARI (Availability-Rate-Inventory) webservice, add-on service products, and PDF booking vouchers.

sources.title: OpenTravel Alliance (OTA) message specifications
sources.license: OTA user license — free to use, may not redistribute/modify the specification text
sources.version: public mirror through 2017B; current releases through 2024A are member/download-gated
sources.notes: Verified organizational facts and access status only (public mirror stops at 2017B; the OpenTravel site's download form lists newer releases behind registration). Did not obtain and read the full current message schema text in this pass, so this source is NOT treated as sufficient alone for 'high' confidence on any feature — cited for terminology (e.g. OTA_HotelResRQ/RS, availability/rate/inventory message families) that is independently well documented in secondary literature, not for message-level detail.

sources.title: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) interface specifications
sources.version: active as of January 2025 release cycle; organization merged into AHLA in 2022
sources.notes: Verified via secondary reporting (Hospitality Technology, AltexSoft, Wikipedia) that HTNG is still active and that its interfaces frequently carry OpenTravel message payloads; did not access gated specification text directly. Cited for the channel-manager/PMS-interface concept only, at low/medium confidence.

sources.title: woopms (koisystems/api.woopms) — Laravel hotel PMS API
sources.notes: Not cloned (AGPL-3.0 network-copyleft; inspected via gh api contents, reference only, no code copied). Small (6-star) but real Laravel API: Property, RoomType, Room, RatePlan (min_persons/max_persons/min_stay/max_stay/cutoff_days/allotment), RoomRate, RoomRateCalendar, Policy + PolicyRule (type=cancellation/guarantee/deposit/modification, hours_before, charge_based_on=number_nights/percentage_amount/fixed_amount), Booking, BookingRoomstay, BookingChannel. Third independent implementation after Frappe Hospitality and QloApps; its Policy/PolicyRule model closely matches this domain's cancellation_policy entity (cutoff_hours/refund_percentage) and its RatePlan min/max-stay + cutoff_days matches rate_restriction.

sources.title: Hotelio (mehedijaman/hotelio) — Laravel hotel management system
sources.notes: Not cloned (inspected via gh api contents). 42-star Laravel app scoped to front-office + accounting: Hotel, Room, Guest, Booking, RoomTransfer, Invoice (GuestID, TaxID, PaymentMethod, SubTotal/TaxTotal/Total) with a separate InvoiceItem (Name, Description, Qty, UnitPrice, Price) line-item table, plus AccountLedger/Balance/Bank/Expense/Income. Its Invoice+InvoiceItem split is the clearest evidence found of an itemized per-stay charge ledger distinct from a single order/invoice.

sources.title: GuestHub (sahdoio/guesthub) — DDD/Clean Architecture Laravel hotel management system
sources.license: none found (no LICENSE file in the repository; all-rights-reserved by default; verify before any reuse)
sources.notes: Not cloned. Small, actively-developed (pushed 2026-05) modular-monolith rebuild with bounded contexts: Billing (Invoice/LineItem/Payment domain objects with IssueInvoice/VoidInvoice/RefundInvoice commands and InvoiceStatus value object), Stay (Reservation with pending/confirmed/checked_in/checked_out/cancelled states, and a separate SpecialRequest entity for early-check-in/late-check-out/extra-bed/dietary/special-occasion requests), and IAM (a LoyaltyTier enum — bronze/silver/gold/platinum — with a UserLoyaltyTierChanged domain event). The LoyaltyTier enum is the clearest implementation evidence found of guest loyalty tiers modeled as a first-class, separately-tracked concept.

features.name: Property management
features.description: Define a hotel/property: name, address, policies, and default settings.

features.name: Room types
features.description: Categories of rooms (e.g. Standard, Deluxe, Suite) with capacity and amenities shared across physical rooms.

features.name: Rooms
features.description: Individual physical rooms belonging to a room type, with their own status (active/inactive/out of order).

features.name: Rates and rate plans
features.description: Date-ranged pricing per room type (e.g. seasonal rate, non-refundable rate, package rate).

features.name: Availability and inventory
features.description: Real-time count of sellable rooms per room type per date, used to block overselling.

provenance.notes: Neither implementation has a dedicated 'inventory' entity distinct from summing reservation date ranges against room status; availability is computed, not stored, in both.

features.name: Reservations
features.description: Book one or more rooms for a date range and guest count; tracks status from request through stay completion.

features.name: Front desk check-in / check-out
features.description: Record a guest's arrival (assign/confirm room, ID capture) and departure (settle folio, release room).

provenance.notes: QloApps' HotelBookingDetail has explicit Assigned/CheckedIn/CheckedOut states; Frappe Hospitality only has a terminal 'Completed' status with no explicit check-in event — a weaker but real signal.

features.name: Guest profiles
features.description: Guest identity, contact info, preferences, and stay history, reused across reservations.

features.name: Folio and charges
features.description: Running itemized ledger of room charges, taxes, and incidentals for a stay, settled at checkout.

provenance.notes: Neither implementation has a distinct running folio; both settle a reservation against a single order/invoice (frappe: Sales Invoice; QloApps: PrestaShop Order) rather than an itemized per-stay ledger. Classified as common on general PMS industry practice. Corroborated by two further implementations: Hotelio's Invoice+InvoiceItem (itemized line items per invoice) and GuestHub's Billing bounded context (Invoice/LineItem/Payment with issue/void/refund lifecycle). Neither ties the ledger to a single in-progress stay the way a hotel-specific 'folio' term implies, but both model an itemized, multi-line charge ledger distinct from a single order — direct structural evidence for the feature.

features.name: Channel manager / OTA distribution
features.description: Push rate, availability, and inventory (ARI) to and pull reservations from online travel agencies.

provenance.notes: Only QloApps (of the two inspected implementations) has this; OTA/HTNG confirm the concept and its OTA_HotelAvail/OTA_HotelResRQ-style terminology organizationally, but their current message-schema text was not directly read in this pass (access-gated) — not counted alone as sufficient for 'high'.

features.name: Rate restrictions
features.description: Minimum/maximum length of stay, closed-to-arrival/departure, and blackout-date rules on a rate plan.

provenance.notes: Corroborated by woopms's RatePlan (min_stay, max_stay, cutoff_days) — a second, independent implementation of stay-length and booking-window restrictions, alongside QloApps's more complete restriction set (min/max stay, closed-to-arrival/departure, blackout dates).

features.name: Cancellation and refund policies
features.description: Property- or rate-level rules for how much of a payment is refundable based on how close to arrival a guest cancels.

provenance.notes: Corroborated by woopms's Policy/PolicyRule model (type=cancellation, hours_before, charge_based_on=number_nights/percentage_amount/fixed_amount) — a second, independent implementation of cutoff-based refund-percentage rules, matching this domain's cancellation_policy entity closely.

features.name: Deposits and advance payment
features.description: Collect a partial or full payment at booking time, ahead of the stay.

features.name: Amenities
features.description: Named features attached to a property or room type (e.g. Wi-Fi, pool, breakfast included).

features.name: Add-on services
features.description: Purchasable extras attached to a stay (breakfast, airport transfer, spa) beyond the room rate.

provenance.notes: Corroborated by Frappe Hospitality's Hotel Room Package / Hotel Room Pricing Package doctypes (a named bundle of amenities linked to a priced Item, with its own date-ranged rate) alongside QloApps's ServiceProduct classes. The two implementations model this differently — Frappe bundles the extra into a room-rate package rather than an itemized per-stay add-on the way QloApps does — so this is real but heterogeneous evidence, not a settled pattern.

features.name: Booking voucher / confirmation
features.description: Generate and send a guest-facing confirmation document for a reservation.

features.name: Connecting / adjoining rooms
features.description: Model and offer physically connected rooms as a unit for families or groups.

features.name: Multi-property management
features.description: Manage room types, rates, and reservations across a group of properties from one account.

provenance.notes: Frappe's Hotel Settings is scoped per Company (weak signal); QloApps' HotelBranchInformation is explicitly multi-branch.

features.name: Housekeeping
features.description: Track room cleaning/turnover status (dirty, cleaning, clean, inspected) and assign housekeeping tasks.

provenance.notes: Neither implementation has a dedicated housekeeping module; QloApps' room active/inactive/temporary-inactive status is a partial, generic analog, not a turnover workflow.

features.name: Night audit
features.description: End-of-day process that posts room charges, reconciles payments, and rolls the business date forward.

provenance.notes: Not present in either inspected implementation; reasoned from standard PMS industry practice.

features.name: Group bookings
features.description: Reserve a block of multiple rooms under one booking for an event, family, or corporate group.

provenance.notes: Inferred from both implementations supporting multiple room line-items per reservation/cart, not from an explicit 'group booking' or rooming-list concept in either.

features.name: Guest loyalty program
features.description: Points, tiers, or member rates tied to a guest's stay history.

provenance.notes: Not present in either inspected implementation; reasoned from common industry practice. Corroborated by GuestHub's LoyaltyTier enum (bronze/silver/gold/platinum) and UserLoyaltyTierChanged domain event — a second, independent implementation of guest loyalty as a first-class, separately tracked concept, alongside the existing secondary (Wikipedia) source.

features.name: Guest reviews
features.description: Collect and display post-stay ratings and feedback.

provenance.notes: Not present in either inspected implementation; reasoned from common industry practice. Corroborated by QloApps's own qlohotelreview module (QhrHotelReview class, category-based ratings, hooked to trigger after booking-status updates) — a second, independent implementation of guest reviews as a dedicated feature, alongside the existing secondary (Wikipedia) source. Not found in Frappe Hospitality, woopms, hotelio, or guesthub.

features.name: Dynamic / yield-based pricing
features.description: Adjust room rates automatically based on demand, occupancy forecast, or competitor pricing.

provenance.notes: Distinct from the rule/season-based rate plans both implementations have; true demand-responsive pricing was not found in either.
